body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 028495f5c22e13c22e45921a47b27c81525b4a10 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The guide matches the shipped provider controls, credential lookup, selection replies, turn undo and posting approval rules. The four tasks include 20 JSON-RPC tool calls. The tests check tool names, argument keys, required arguments and CamCraft flags against the application. The guide states the limits for other local runtimes and excludes the unfinished scope from #1944 and #1947.

Results merged with main, locally:
- Trial merge with upstream/main `97a880c53e0f8158348410dac152db4ca99f277c`: clean.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test ai_guide --no-run`: pass.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: pass. The `ai_guide` suite has 2 passed tests, 0 failures and 0 ignored tests.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: pass.
- `python3 -B -m unittest discover -s site/tests -p test_ai_guide.py`: 3 passed tests.
- Zola 0.23.6: build passes with 48 pages, 10 sections and no orphan pages.
- `git diff --check upstream/main`: pass.

Extra suites run:
- `ZOLA=/tmp/zola python3 -B -m unittest discover -s site/tests -p test_guide_navigation.py`: 5 passed tests. The first attempt could not find Zola on PATH. The rerun uses the installed binary and passes.
- The diff changes no fixtures, goldens or importer code. No extra kernel or importer suite is required.

Heavy lanes: `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run` reports no reached heavy lane.

Safety tier: not required. This PR changes documentation and tests. It changes no posted G-code, geometry, stock simulation, collision check or gouge check. No goldens moved. Mutations: not run; the safety-tier requirement does not apply.

Requested before merge: none.

Notes: No live provider calls, credentials, external client installations or physical machine tests were used. This PR changes no `crates/ui` UI, so before/after screenshots are not required. No GitHub runner was used. The review checks the laws in current upstream main's AGENTS.md.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Merge class: SAME (no commit after the reviewed head). This merge relies on the review by mkinney with the marker for head `028495f5c22e13c22e45921a47b27c81525b4a10`. The PR changes guide pages, tests and a decision file.
